terms.comment: Plural indicēs numericī; our working technical expression for numerical metrics. Recovered from our 16 October discussion. These are proposals, not a verified community standard. API resource names must be interpreted from the platform’s own definitions: some “metrics” resources describe tracked event types rather than numerical values.
index also has other senses, including a list; the qualifier numericus can disambiguate.
Plural numerī; our informal choice when thinking about the reported statistics.
Useful when the measure itself is the focus.

phrases.english: I need to check the figures.

sources: Lewis & Short: index · Lewis & Short: numerus · Lewis & Short: mensura. Dictionary links support the component words; the modern technical expressions are labelled separately.
The example sentences marked “composed” are ours.
